title: Code Lesson Checkpoints
user: A remote programming tutor who needs to see a learner’s runnable milestones and misconceptions without constantly taking over their screen.
smallest_useful_product: VS Code extension and tiny backend: instructor defines shell/test checkpoints; student runs locally and shares only command status, selected output, and an optional note; teacher sees a timeline.
success_measure: Teachers identify the first blocked checkpoint in under two minutes and prefer it to requesting another screen share in at least 70% of sessions.
monetization: freemium — free individual tutor/student pair; paid small-team history and roster controls finance secure relay infrastructure.
constraints: Never upload source by default; redact environment variables and cap output; consent indicators for both parties; FERPA/GDPR-ready deletion and access controls.
